# Tests that are not #[ignore]d but check part of what they test only as
# root, for the rust_test job in .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml: as the
# runner's user they skip that part and say so (`skipped:` or `UNKNOWN:`).
# The job takes each out of the main invocation and runs it alone as root
# (`sudo -E`, out of linux-sandbox, which maps one uid), with `--exact
# <name>`, after the other root runs. It fails unless each runs there, and
# when one prints `UNKNOWN:` there.
# One per line: <bazel test target> <libtest test name>  <what it needs root for>.
//crates/pi-iso:pi-iso_test cow::tests::a_clone_refused_for_a_device_leaves_nothing  mknod of a character device (CAP_MKNOD) as the clone's source
//crates/pi-vfs:pi-vfs_test dir_handle::tests::unix::a_masked_create_dir_at_returns_the_error_of_setting_the_mode  its second half: a directory root owns put at the name while the process acts as another user
//crates/pi-vfs:pi-vfs_test dir_handle::tests::unix::chown_at_changes_the_entry_named  chown_at to other ids, and of a symlink itself
